name: Extra Block Types (EBT): Webform
project_description: Extra Block Types (EBT): Webform ships a single reusable custom block type, 'EBT Webform' (block_content bundle ebt_webform), that references a Webform and renders it inline together with the EBT design/styling controls (spacing, borders, background color/image, edge-to-edge, container width) supplied by the EBT Core field. It is a thin, config-only module: it provides no PHP, routes, services, or permissions of its own. It defines the bundle via config/install, a required Form (webform reference) field, a Text (body) field, and the shared EBT Block settings field, then relies on ebt_core to preprocess the block and emit the generated inline CSS. The block can be placed in Layout Builder, in the classic block layout, or reused anywhere custom blocks are allowed. It is one of the many standalone EBT block-type modules and requires EBT Core, Paragraphs, and Webform.
